messages:
Morgan: Heads up — drafting the release summary for the docs site (v0.12). I have the changelog bullets but need snippet parity verification and the known-issues section. Who's free to review snippets + link fixes today?
Claire: I can take snippets. Which SDKs? JS + Python? :eyes:
Morgan: JS, Python, and Go samples in /sdk/ snippets. Priority: streaming examples and embed migration. Also check the code fence language tags.
Ashok: I'll run the quick snippet linter and run the sample apps. Found one JS snippet that's missing await; will patch. ETA 1 hr.
.docs-bot: Checklist: 1) snippet parity 2) embed migration notes 3) known issues 4) internal redirect links. Add your initials when done. :white_check_mark:
Samir: Note: streaming endpoint changed param name from 'stream=true' to 'streaming=true' — we need a small callout in release notes and update examples.
Claire: Good catch. I'll grep for stream=true and open a PR to replace. Also adding a small callout under 'Breaking changes'
Igna: I spotted a broken anchor in the 'rollout' doc: /docs/rollouts#canary -> should be /docs/rollouts#canary-deploy. Will add redirect to redirects.yaml and a docs comment.
Morgan: Great. For known issues, let's list: 1) embedding dedup bug with v0.12 models 2) transient 502s during cold starts 3) python SDK timeout differences on Windows. Keep descriptions brief.
Ashok: Re: dedup bug—adding repro steps + a small eval script. Putting it in the PR under 'known_issues/k12-embed-dedup.md'
Claire: On snippets: minor API rename in JS client too — replace `createEmbedding` with `embeddings.create`. I'll include a one-line migration note.
Samir: For release CTA, also add recommended configuration for batching: `max_batch_size: 64` and `batch_latency_ms: 50` sample in config section.
Morgan: Can we aim to merge all docs PRs by EOD? If blockers appear, ping me. I'll draft the release blurb after snippets are merged.
.docs-bot: PRs to watch: #4201 docs/snippet-fix-js, #4203 docs/redirect-rollout, #4205 docs/known-issues-embed. Pinged reviewers.
Igna: tiny nit — docs link checker shows /sdk/go/example returns 404 in staging. I'll retest after redirect.
Claire: Merged #4201 with snippet fixes. Left one TODO about code fence language. @Morgan can you confirm wording for the breaking change callout?
Morgan: Draft for breaking change: 'streaming param renamed to streaming=true; update client calls. Old alias will be removed in next minor.' ok to use?
Claire: good. shorten 'update client calls' -> 'update client calls' and add migration snippet.
Morgan: updated. pushing release draft to /internal/release-drafts/v0.12.md — reviewers: @Claire @Ashok @Samir @Igna. I'll tag QA once merged.
Ashok: All snippet lints passed locally. Uploaded patch for the await fix. +1
Samir: I'll follow up on the staging 502 metrics post-deploy, tagging eng-sre if spike > 3%.
Igna: Redirect added and CI passed. Staging link /docs/rollouts#canary-deploy works now.
Morgan: Fantastic. If no more blockers, I'll schedule the docs deploy for 19:00 PT. Anyone need a later time?
Claire: 19:00 PT works for me. :+1:
Ashok: works.
Samir: good.
.docs-bot: Release draft published to internal space. Reminder: update the release checklist once live. :rocket:
